name: my-workflow
description: Enforces rg over grep and a 60-second per-command sleep limit in Bash for Claude Code: grep/egrep/fgrep (incl. full paths, quoted and sh -c variants) are rejected with a prompt to use rg; automatic fallback when rg is absent. rg itself is never blocked. Single sleeps over 60 seconds are rejected unless preceded by SLEEP_GATE=allow.
